text:
jamal: Heads up — we quietly crossed $12M ARR this morning. small but mighty. thinking a tiny celebration in the kitchen at 4:30? low-key vibes (plants, playlist, one or two biodegradable confetti poppers). what do people prefer? 🎯
maria: Yesss congrats!! so proud of the team :tada: count me in for snacks and photos.
alex: love the plant-toast idea. i’ll make a ‘victory’ playlist — drop song recs. also remote, so will join via camera.
carmen: can we do a quick 10–15m huddle for a group photo for socials? timing works for me.
lee: confetti popper = fire alarm risk? maybe a bubble machine or handheld biodegradable confetti only. safety first :safety_vest:
ops-bot: Reminder: All celebratory devices must clear Facilities. Submit a quick form: https://intranet/redwood/facilities/celebrations (auto-checklist attached).
sam: remote but sending GIFs + will Venmo coffee for whoever wants one ☕️ remote cheers.
maria: tiny poll: snacks? react with 1-4 — 1) sushi rolls 2) empanadas 3) vegan charcuterie 4) churros.
jamal: also want to give a big shout to @maria and @lee for the late-night launch-wrangling last week — they were the glue.
lee: thanks!! whole team moved fast, great work everyone :raised_hands:
carmen: idea: we match up to $200 in donations to the local food bank as a celebration gesture. volunteer sign-up link?
jamal: love that. i’ll post a short announcement and donation link in #announcements after lunch.
alex: adding a 2-line writeup to the internal newsletter — if you want a one-liner about your team's wins, dm me.
sam: posting celebratory GIF now: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-hype-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 (reacted :partyparrot: by jamal)
maria: ok snacks leaning toward empanadas from LaRosa — anyone allergic to nuts or gluten?
lee: gluten-free pls for me.
jamal: got it. ordering a mix. office meet in kitchen at 4:30 — remote peeps, link will be posted. tiny, low-key, plants & bubbles. thanks team — huge milestone, quietly owned.
ops-bot: Event created: "12M ARR mini-toast" at 16:30 in Kitchen. Facilities notified.
